title: Total degree of the affine-substituted squarefree monomial
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $\omega \in K$, and fix $n \in \bbn$ together with a subset $s \subseteq \{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$. Then the total degree of the affine-substituted squarefree monomial $\prod_{i \in s}\bigl(1 + \omega^{-1} - \omega^{-1} X_i\bigr)$, viewed as a polynomial in $K[X_0, \dots, X_{n-1}]$, is at most $\abs{s}$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite subset s of the index set Fin n
replaced: The total degree of $\mathrm{affineSquarefreeMonomial}\,\omega\,s$ is at most $\abs{s}$.
